description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ModifyAclEntry' which represents a command to modify a single ACL (Access Control List) entry of a Thing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and relevant properties for handling ACL modifications, and is marked as deprecated.
